affirmations.text: I can feel nervous and still take a small step.
I do not need to be perfect to connect with people.
A pause in conversation is normal.
I can learn from uncomfortable moments.
My worth does not depend on everyone's opinion.
Progress matters more than perfection.
It is okay to take things at my own pace.
Small steps add up over time.
Most people are focused on themselves, and many feel nervous too.
I can ask for what I need, kindly and clearly.
I can take a slow breath before I speak.
Feeling nervous does not mean something is wrong.
I can let a feeling be here without letting it decide for me.
I am allowed to be a work in progress.
One awkward moment does not define me.
I can be kind to myself when things do not go to plan.
It is okay to be quiet, and it is okay to speak up.
Every small step is still a step.
Trying again is part of learning.
I have already done hard things.
Most conversations do not need to be perfect to be good.
Asking a question is a simple way to connect.
I can say no kindly and still be a good person.
People are often glad when someone says hello.
